1001.zh: 这块玉石在阳光下晶莹剔透。
1001.py: Zhè kuài yù shí zài yáng guāng xià jīng yíng tī tòu.
1001.en: This jade stone is crystal clear in sunlight.

1002.zh: 我们住在一个安静美丽的小镇上。
1002.py: Wǒ men zhù zài yí gè ān jìng měi lì de xiǎo zhèn shàng.
1002.en: We live in a quiet, beautiful small town.

1003.zh: 昨晚外面下了一场厚厚的白雪。
1003.py: Zuó wǎn wài miàn xià le yī cháng hòu hòu de bái xuě.
1003.en: A thick white snow fell outside last night.

1004.zh: 我们今天中午在食堂吃面条。
1004.py: Wǒ men jīn tiān zhōng wǔ zài shí táng chī miàn tiáo.
1004.en: We will eat noodles in the canteen this noon.

1005.zh: 他每天下午都认真练习书法。
1005.py: Tā měi tiān xià wǔ dōu rèn zhēn liàn xí shū fǎ.
1005.en: He practices calligraphy earnestly every afternoon.

1006.zh: 遇到紧迫的事情不要慌张。
1006.py: Yù dào jǐn pò de shì qíng bú yào huāng zhāng.
1006.en: Do not panic when encountering urgent matters.

1007.zh: 爷爷每天早晨都去公园打太极拳。
1007.py: Yé yé měi tiān zǎo chén dōu qù gōng yuán dǎ tài jí quán.
1007.en: Grandpa goes to the park to do Tai Chi every morning.

1008.zh: 请大家认真阅读这篇优美的课文。
1008.py: Qǐng dà jiā rèn zhēn yuè dú zhè piān yōu měi de kè wén.
1008.en: Please read this beautiful text carefully, everyone.

1009.zh: 今天晚饭妈妈做了好吃的牛肉。
1009.py: Jīn tiān wǎn fàn mā mā zuò le hǎo chī de niú ròu.
1009.en: Mom cooked delicious beef for dinner today.

1010.zh: 吃饭的时候不要大声张嘴说话。
1010.py: Chī fàn de shí hòu bú yào dà shēng zhāng zuǐ shuō huà.
1010.en: Do not talk loudly with mouth open while eating.

1011.zh: 周末我和同学去图书馆看书。
1011.py: Zhōu mò wǒ hé tóng xué qù tú shū guǎn kàn shū.
1011.en: I go to the library to read with classmates on weekends.

1012.zh: 这本经典小说我已经读过三遍了。
1012.py: Zhè běn jīng diǎn xiǎo shuō wǒ yǐ jīng dú guò sān biàn le.
1012.en: I have already read this classic novel three times.

1013.zh: 他虽然很平凡，但工作非常敬业。
1013.py: Tā suī rán hěn píng fán, dàn gōng zuò fēi cháng jìng yè.
1013.en: Although he is ordinary, he is very dedicated in work.

1014.zh: 学好拼音是学好汉语的基础。
1014.py: Xué hǎo pīn yīn shì xué hǎo hàn yǔ de jī chǔ.
1014.en: Learning pinyin well is the foundation of mastering Chinese.

1015.zh: 山脚下有一个神秘天然的大山洞。
1015.py: Shān jiǎo xià yǒu yí gè shén mì tiān rán de dà shān dòng.
1015.en: There is a mysterious natural cave at the foot of the mountain.

1016.zh: 老师在办公室里认真批改试卷。
1016.py: Lǎo shī zài bàn gōng shì lǐ rèn zhēn pī gǎi shì juàn.
1016.en: The teacher is correcting exam papers in the office.

1017.zh: 这片草地非常平坦，适合散步。
1017.py: Zhè piàn cǎo dì fēi cháng píng tǎn, shì hé sàn bù.
1017.en: This lawn is very flat, suitable for taking a walk.

1018.zh: 草地上有几头奶牛在悠闲吃草。
1018.py: Cǎo dì shàng yǒu jǐ tóu nǎi niú zài yōu xián chī cǎo.
1018.en: Several cows are eating grass leisurely on the grass.

1019.zh: 清晨的校园非常宁静美好。
1019.py: Qīng chén de xiào yuán fēi cháng níng jìng měi hǎo.
1019.en: The campus in early morning is very peaceful and beautiful.

1020.zh: 请给我一张白纸写生词。
1020.py: Qǐng gěi wǒ yī zhāng bái zhǐ xiě shēng cí.
1020.en: Please give me a sheet of white paper to write new words.

1021.zh: 诸位老师和同学，大家早上好！
1021.py: Zhū wèi lǎo shī hé tóng xué, dà jiā zǎo shàng hǎo!
1021.en: All teachers and students, good morning everyone!

1022.zh: 经过几个星期的训练，他进步很大。
1022.py: Jīng guò jǐ gè xīng qī de xùn liàn, tā jìn bù hěn dà.
1022.en: After several weeks of training, he made great progress.

1023.zh: 未经允许不要看别人的隐私。
1023.py: Wèi jīng yǔn xǔ bú yào kàn bié rén de yǐn sī.
1023.en: Do not look at others' private matters without permission.

1024.zh: 村庄里种着许多绿油油的庄稼。
1024.py: Cūn zhuāng lǐ zhǒng zhe xǔ duō lǜ yóu yóu de zhuāng jià.
1024.en: Many green crops are planted in the village.

1025.zh: 我们要热爱我们伟大的祖国。
1025.py: Wǒ men yào rè ài wǒ men wěi dà de zǔ guó.
1025.en: We must love our great motherland.

1026.zh: 春风带来了一丝丝清凉的感觉。
1026.py: Chūn fēng dài lái le yī sī sī qīng liáng de gǎn jué.
1026.en: The spring breeze brought a trace of cool feeling.

1027.zh: 请大家把课本翻到第五十页。
1027.py: Qǐng dà jiā bǎ kè běn fān dào dì wǔ shí yè.
1027.en: Please turn your textbooks to page fifty, everyone.

1028.zh: 窗外突然刮起了一场大风暴。
1028.py: Chuāng wài tū rán guā qǐ le yī cháng dà fēng bào.
1028.en: A big storm suddenly blew up outside the window.

1029.zh: 大森林里生活着许多小动物。
1029.py: Dà sēn lín lǐ shēng huó zhe xǔ duō xiǎo dòng wù.
1029.en: Many small animals live in the big forest.

1030.zh: 山顶上有一座高高的大佛塔。
1030.py: Shān dǐng shàng yǒu yī zuò gāo gāo de dà fó tǎ.
1030.en: There is a tall Buddhist pagoda on the mountain peak.

1031.zh: 教室里的同学们都在默读课文。
1031.py: Jiào shì lǐ de tóng xué men dōu zài mò dú kè wén.
1031.en: Students in the classroom are silently reading texts.

1032.zh: 两位老朋友见面时紧紧握手。
1032.py: Liǎng wèi lǎo péng yǒu jiàn miàn shí jǐn jǐn wò shǒu.
1032.en: The two old friends shook hands tightly when meeting.

1033.zh: 放学后小孩子们在操场上做游戏。
1033.py: Fàng xué hòu xiǎo hái zi men zài cāo chǎng shàng zuò yóu xì.
1033.en: Little children play games on the playground after school.

1034.zh: 树林后隐隐约约有一座小木屋。
1034.py: Shù lín hòu yǐn yǐn yuē yuē yǒu yī zuò xiǎo mù wū.
1034.en: Behind the woods there is faintly a small wooden cabin.

1035.zh: 树上的红苹果都已经完全成熟了。
1035.py: Shù shàng de hóng píng guǒ dōu yǐ jīng wán quán chéng shú le.
1035.en: The red apples on the tree have ripened completely.

1036.zh: 喝牛奶可以帮助骨骼健康发育。
1036.py: Hē niú nǎi kě yǐ bāng zhù gǔ gé jiàn kāng fā yù.
1036.en: Drinking milk can help bones develop healthily.

1037.zh: 明天下午我们要去拜访李老师。
1037.py: Míng tiān xià wǔ wǒ men yào qù bài fǎng lǐ lǎo shī.
1037.en: We will visit Teacher Li tomorrow afternoon.

1038.zh: 生病之后身体会感觉有点虚弱。
1038.py: Shēng bìng zhī hòu shēn tǐ huì gǎn jué yǒu diǎn xū ruò.
1038.en: The body will feel a bit weak after being sick.

1039.zh: 清晨大山上笼罩着一层迷蒙晨雾。
1039.py: Qīng chén dà shān shàng lǒng zhào zhe yī céng mí méng chén wù.
1039.en: A layer of hazy morning mist shrouded the mountain at dawn.

1040.zh: 大家在晚会上开心地唱歌跳舞。
1040.py: Dà jiā zài wǎn huì shàng kāi xīn de chàng gē tiào wǔ.
1040.en: Everyone sang and danced happily at the evening party.

1041.zh: 学校门口新开了一家面条店。
1041.py: Xué xiào mén kǒu xīn kāi le yī jiā miàn tiáo diàn.
1041.en: A new noodle shop opened at the school entrance.

1042.zh: 弟弟喜欢戴着滑稽的鬼脸面具。
1042.py: Dì di xǐ huān dài zhe huá jī de guǐ liǎn miàn jù.
1042.en: Younger brother likes wearing a funny ghost mask.

1043.zh: 这张沙发非常柔软舒适好坐。
1043.py: Zhè zhāng shā fā fēi cháng róu ruǎn shū shì hǎo zuò.
1043.en: This sofa is very soft, comfortable, and easy to sit on.

1044.zh: 在图书馆遇到不懂的词可以查字典。
1044.py: Zài tú shū guǎn yù dào bù dǒng de cí kě yǐ chá zì diǎn.
1044.en: You can look up dictionaries when meeting unknown words in library.

1045.zh: 多运动能够增强食欲，有益健康。
1045.py: Duō yùn dòng néng gòu zēng qiáng shí yù, yǒu yì jiàn kāng.
1045.en: More exercise can increase appetite and benefit health.

1046.zh: 拉萨是西藏著名的日光之城。
1046.py: Lā sà shì xī zàng zhù míng de rì guāng zhī chéng.
1046.en: Lhasa is Tibet's famous city of sunlight.

1047.zh: 那个聪明活泼的小伙子是新同学。
1047.py: Nà ge cōng míng huó pō de xiǎo huǒ zi shì xīn tóng xué.
1047.en: That smart and lively young fellow is a new classmate.

1048.zh: 出门遇到大雨，衣服遭受了淋湿。
1048.py: Chū mén yù dào dà yǔ, yī fú zāo shòu le lín shī.
1048.en: Met heavy rain when going out, and clothes suffered getting soaked.

1049.zh: 桌子上摆着一盘新鲜的红草莓。
1049.py: Zhuō zi shàng bǎi zhe yī pán xīn xiān de hóng cǎo méi.
1049.en: A plate of fresh red strawberries is placed on the table.

1050.zh: 爸爸每天晚上都辅导我写作业。
1050.py: Bà bà měi tiān wǎn shàng dōu fǔ dǎo wǒ xiě zuò yè.
1050.en: Dad tutors me with homework every evening.

1051.zh: 学校正在扩建新的现代化图书馆。
1051.py: Xué xiào zhèng zài kuò jiàn xīn de xiàn dài huà tú shū guǎn.
1051.en: The school is expanding a new modern library.

1052.zh: 睡觉时记得盖好保暖的被子。
1052.py: Shuì jiào shí jì de gài hǎo bǎo nuǎn de bèi zi.
1052.en: Remember to cover yourself with a warm quilt when sleeping.

1053.zh: 请不要把新买的课本弄脏了。
1053.py: Qǐng bú yào bǎ xīn mǎi de kè běn nòng zāng le.
1053.en: Please do not make your newly bought textbook dirty.

1054.zh: 大公鸡在清晨发出了雄壮的啼叫。
1054.py: Dà gōng jī zài qīng chén fā chū le xióng zhuàng de tí jiào.
1054.en: The rooster made a majestic crowing sound in early morning.

1055.zh: 端着热汤走路一定要稳稳当当。
1055.py: Duān zhe rè tāng zǒu lù yí dìng yào wěn wěn dāng dāng.
1055.en: Be very steady when walking while holding hot soup.

1056.zh: 出门前别忘了带上自己的雨伞。
1056.py: Chū mén qián bié wàng le dài shàng zì jǐ de yǔ sǎn.
1056.en: Do not forget to bring your umbrella before going out.

1057.zh: 中国拥有十四亿勤劳的人民。
1057.py: Zhōng guó yōng yǒu shí sì yì qín láo de rén mín.

1058.zh: 玫瑰花虽美，但茎上长着小刺。
1058.py: Méi guī huā suī měi, dàn jīng shàng zhǎng zhe xiǎo cì.
1058.en: Although roses are beautiful, small thorns grow on stems.

1059.zh: 久别重逢的朋友紧紧拥抱在一起。
1059.py: Jiǔ bié chóng féng de péng yǒu jǐn jǐn yōng bào zài yì qǐ.
1059.en: Friends reunited after a long separation hugged tightly.

1060.zh: 他是一名热爱厨艺的小学徒。
1060.py: Tā shì yī míng rè ài chú yì de xiǎo xué tú.
1060.en: He is a small apprentice who loves culinary arts.

1061.zh: 保姆阿姨每天把家里收拾得很干净。
1061.py: Bǎo mǔ ā yí měi tiān bǎ jiā lǐ shōu shí de hěn gān jìng.
1061.en: The nanny aunt tidies up the home cleanly every day.

1062.zh: 湖边栽满了翠绿高大的杨树。
1062.py: Hú biān zāi mǎn le cuì lǜ gāo dà de yáng shù.
1062.en: Tall green poplar trees are planted by the lake.

1063.zh: 大家排着整齐的队伍走进考场。
1063.py: Dà jiā pái zhe zhěng qí de duì wǔ zǒu jìn kǎo chǎng.
1063.en: Everyone lined up in neat rows and entered the exam room.

1064.zh: 我们班在足球比赛中赢得了冠军。
1064.py: Wǒ men bān zài zú qiú bǐ sài zhōng yíng de le guàn jūn.
1064.en: Our class won the championship in the soccer match.

1065.zh: 这本童话书讲了一个有趣的故事。
1065.py: Zhè běn tóng huà shū jiǎng le yí gè yǒu qù de gù shì.
1065.en: This fairy tale book tells an interesting story.

1066.zh: 他用小提琴演奏了一首优美的乐曲。
1066.py: Tā yòng xiǎo tí qín yǎn zòu le yī shǒu yōu měi de yuè qǔ.
1066.en: He played a beautiful piece of music on the violin.

1067.zh: 用刀切水果时一定要小心手。
1067.py: Yòng dāo qiè shuǐ guǒ shí yí dìng yào xiǎo xīn shǒu.
1067.en: Be careful with hands when cutting fruit with a knife.

1068.zh: 每天早晨起床后要把床铺收拾整齐。
1068.py: Měi tiān zǎo chén qǐ chuáng hòu yào bǎ chuáng pù shōu shí zhěng qí.
1068.en: Tidy up the bed neatly every morning after getting up.

1069.zh: 热烈欢迎新同学来到我们班级！
1069.py: Rè liè huān yíng xīn tóng xué lái dào wǒ men bān jí!
1069.en: Warmly welcome new classmates to our class!

1070.zh: 冬天河面上结了一层厚厚的冰块。
1070.py: Dōng tiān hé miàn shàng jié le yī céng hòu hòu de bīng kuài.
1070.en: A thick layer of ice froze on the river surface in winter.

1071.zh: 虚心听取别人的意见能让人进步。
1071.py: Xū xīn tīng qǔ bié rén de yì jiàn néng ràng rén jìn bù.
1071.en: Listening open-mindedly to others' opinions brings progress.

1072.zh: 周末小孩子们在公园里开心地玩耍。
1072.py: Zhōu mò xiǎo hái zi men zài gōng yuán lǐ kāi xīn de wán shuǎ.
1072.en: Little children played happily in the park on weekends.

1073.zh: 老师在黑板上详细分析了这道题。
1073.py: Lǎo shī zài hēi bǎn shàng xiáng xì fēn xī le zhè dào tí.
1073.en: The teacher analyzed this problem in detail on the blackboard.

1074.zh: 请把教室里的窗户打开透透气。
1074.py: Qǐng bǎ jiào shì lǐ de chuāng hù dǎ kāi tòu tòu qì.
1074.en: Please open windows in the classroom for fresh air.

1075.zh: 早晨闹钟一响他就立刻清醒了。
1075.py: Zǎo chén nào zhōng yī xiǎng tā jiù lì kè qīng xǐng le.
1075.en: He immediately woke up as soon as the morning alarm rang.

1076.zh: 他们是一对相亲相爱的恩爱夫妻。
1076.py: Tā men shì yī duì xiāng qīn xiāng ài de ēn ài fū qī.
1076.en: They are an affectionate and loving married couple.

1077.zh: 温暖的阳光透过树叶照在草地上。
1077.py: Wēn nuǎn de yáng guāng tòu guò shù yè zhào zài cǎo dì shàng.
1077.en: Warm sunlight shone on the grass through tree leaves.

1078.zh: 周末妈妈去商场购买了新鲜水果。
1078.py: Zhōu mò mā mā qù shāng chǎng gòu mǎi le xīn xiān shuǐ guǒ.
1078.en: Mom went to the shopping mall on weekends to buy fresh fruits.

1079.zh: 今天王老师替病假的李老师上课。
1079.py: Jīn tiān wáng lǎo shī tì bìng jià de lǐ lǎo shī shàng kè.
1079.en: Teacher Wang substitutes in class today for Teacher Li.

1080.zh: 每天上下班高峰期路上都很堵塞。
1080.py: Měi tiān shàng xià bān gāo fēng qī lù shàng dōu hěn dǔ sè.
1080.en: Roads are very congested during daily rush hours.

1081.zh: 只要我们努力学习，就一定能成功。
1081.py: Zhǐ yào wǒ men nǔ lì xué xí, jiù yí dìng néng chéng gōng.
1081.en: As long as we study hard, we will definitely succeed.

1082.zh: 写完作业后让眼睛休息十分钟。
1082.py: Xiě wán zuò yè hòu ràng yǎn jīng xiū xī shí fēn zhōng.
1082.en: Let your eyes rest for ten minutes after finishing homework.

1083.zh: 动物园里有一只威武的大老虎。
1083.py: Dòng wù yuán lǐ yǒu yī zhī wēi wǔ de dà lǎo hǔ.
1083.en: There is a majestic big tiger in the zoo.

1084.zh: 鲜艳的国旗在阳光下高高飘扬。
1084.py: Xiān yàn de guó qí zài yáng guāng xià gāo gāo piāo yáng.
1084.en: The bright national flag flutters high in sunlight.

1085.zh: 我们在旅游途中拍了许多美丽照片。
1085.py: Wǒ men zài lǚ yóu tú zhōng pāi le xǔ duō měi lì zhào piān.
1085.en: We took many beautiful photos during our trip.

1086.zh: 我们要坚决保护自己的权益不受侵害。
1086.py: Wǒ men yào jiān jué bǎo hù zì jǐ de quán yì bù shòu qīn hài.
1086.en: We must resolutely protect our rights from being infringed.

1087.zh: 每个公民都应当懂法，远离刑事犯罪。
1087.py: Měi gè gōng mín dōu yīng dāng dǒng fǎ, yuǎn lí xíng shì fàn zuì.
1087.en: Every citizen should know the law, staying away from crime.

1088.zh: 春天到了，草地上铺满了绿草。
1088.py: Chūn tiān dào le, cǎo dì shàng pù mǎn le lǜ cǎo.
1088.en: Spring has arrived, and the grassland is covered with green grass.

1089.zh: 他们兄弟俩在学习上互相帮助。
1089.py: Tā men xiōng dì liǎ zài xué xí shàng hù xiāng bāng zhù.
1089.en: The two brothers help each other in studies.

1090.zh: 随着科技发展，信息传播非常迅速。
1090.py: Suí zhe kē jì fā zhǎn, xìn xī chuán bō fēi cháng xùn sù.
1090.en: With technology development, information spreads rapidly.

1091.zh: 开学前妈妈给我买了一套新文具。
1091.py: Kāi xué qián mā mā gěi wǒ mǎi le yī tào xīn wén jù.
1091.en: Mom bought me a set of new stationery before school started.

1258.py: Duō chī shū cài néng yù fáng gè zhǒng wéi shēng sù quē fá zhèng.
1258.en: Eating vegetables can prevent various vitamin deficiency diseases.

1259.zh: 小孩子常常喜欢模仿大人的动作。
1259.py: Xiǎo hái zi cháng cháng xǐ huān mó fǎng dà rén de dòng zuò.
1259.en: Little children often like to imitate adults' actions.

1260.zh: 老师耐心地倾听了大家的学习心得。
1260.py: Lǎo shī nài xīn de qīng tīng le dà jiā de xué xí xīn de.
1260.en: The teacher listened patiently to everyone's study reflections.

1261.zh: 校门口立着一块写着校训的木牌子。
1261.py: Xiào mén kǒu lì zhe yī kuài xiě zhe xiào xùn de mù pái zi.
1261.en: A wooden signboard with the school motto stands at school gate.

1262.zh: 做数学计算题要细心，别掉入陷阱。
1262.py: Zuò shù xué jì suàn tí yào xì xīn, bié diào rù xiàn jǐng.
1262.en: Be careful with math calculation questions, don't fall into traps.

1263.zh: 清晨许多小鸟在绿树枝头欢快唱歌。
1263.py: Qīng chén xǔ duō xiǎo niǎo zài lǜ shù zhī tóu huān kuài chàng gē.
1263.en: Many little birds sing cheerfully on green tree branches at dawn.

1264.zh: 夏天午后天空中响起了轰隆隆雷声。
1264.py: Xià tiān wǔ hòu tiān kōng zhōng xiǎng qǐ le hōng lōng lóng léi shēng.
1264.en: Rumbling thunder sounded in the sky on a summer afternoon.

1265.zh: 咱们今天放学后一起去图书馆看书吧。
1265.py: Zán men jīn tiān fàng xué hòu yì qǐ qù tú shū guǎn kàn shū ba.
1265.en: Let's go to the library to read books together after school today.

1266.zh: 多吃新鲜蔬菜水果有利于身体健康。
1266.py: Duō chī xīn xiān shū cài shuǐ guǒ yǒu lì yú shēn tǐ jiàn kāng.
1266.en: Eating fresh vegetables and fruits is good for health.

1267.zh: 离开教室前请大家把门窗紧紧关闭。
1267.py: Lí kāi jiào shì qián qǐng dà jiā bǎ mén chuāng jǐn jǐn guān bì.
1267.en: Please close doors and windows tightly before leaving classroom.

1268.zh: 我们要为了实现人生理想而努力奋斗。
1268.py: Wǒ men yào wèi le shí xiàn rén shēng lǐ xiǎng ér nǔ lì fèn dòu.
1268.en: We must strive hard to realize our life ideals.

1269.zh: 全校师生在礼堂里隆重庆祝教师节。
1269.py: Quán xiào shī shēng zài lǐ táng lǐ lóng zhòng qìng zhù jiào shī jié.
1269.en: Teachers and students grandly celebrated Teachers' Day in auditorium.

1270.zh: 遇到火灾险情时，请听指挥迅速撤离。
1270.py: Yù dào huǒ zāi xiǎn qíng shí, qǐng tīng zhǐ huī xùn sù chè lí.
1270.en: When meeting fire danger, follow directions to evacuate quickly.

1271.zh: 听到这个感人故事，她流下了眼泪。
1271.py: Tīng dào zhè ge gǎn rén gù shì, tā liú xià le yǎn lèi.
1271.en: Hearing this touching story, she shed tears.

1272.zh: 爷爷每天早晨起床后喜欢泡一壶热茶。
1272.py: Yé yé měi tiān zǎo chén qǐ chuáng hòu xǐ huān pào yī hú rè chá.
1272.en: Grandpa likes brewing a pot of hot tea every morning after getting up.

1273.zh: 保持良好卫生习惯能有效预防传染疾病。
1273.py: Bǎo chí liáng hǎo wèi shēng xí guàn néng yǒu xiào yù fáng chuán rǎn jí bìng.
1273.en: Maintaining good hygiene habits can effectively prevent infectious diseases.

1274.zh: 我们分在同一个班级真是一段好缘分。
1274.py: Wǒ men fēn zài tóng yī gè bān jí zhēn shì yī duàn hǎo yuán fēn.
1274.en: It is really good fate that we are allocated to the same class.

1275.zh: 广播电台每天早晨按时播送最新新闻。
1275.py: Guǎng bō diàn tái měi tiān zǎo chén àn shí bō sòng zuì xīn xīn wén.
1275.en: The radio station broadcasts latest news on time every morning.

1276.zh: 同学们在晨读课上声音响亮朗读课文。
1276.py: Tóng xué men zài chén dú kè shǎng shēng yīn xiǎng liàng lǎng dú kè wén.
1276.en: Students read texts aloud with loud voices in morning reading.

1277.zh: 我们要从源头上杜绝浪费粮食的行为。
1277.py: Wǒ men yào cóng yuán tóu shàng dù jué làng fèi liáng shí de xíng wéi.
1277.en: We must eliminate behaviors of wasting food at the source.

1278.zh: 每天早晨喝一杯热牛奶补充丰富钙质。
1278.py: Měi tiān zǎo chén hē yī bēi rè niú nǎi bǔ chōng fēng fù gài zhì.
1278.en: Drinking hot milk every morning replenishes abundant calcium.

1279.zh: 一年有春夏秋冬四个风景优美的季节。
1279.py: Yī nián yǒu chūn xià qiū dōng sì gè fēng jǐng yōu měi de jì jié.
1279.en: A year has four scenic seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter.

1280.zh: 大自然在秋天为枫树换上了丹红新装。
1280.py: Dà zì rán zài qiū tiān wèi fēng shù huàn shàng le dān hóng xīn zhuāng.
1280.en: Nature put a cinnabar-red new coat on maple trees in autumn.

1281.zh: 小狗摇着欢快的小尾巴跑向主人身边。
1281.py: Xiǎo gǒu yáo zhe huān kuài de xiǎo wěi ba pǎo xiàng zhǔ rén shēn biān.
1281.en: The little dog ran towards its master wagging its happy tail.

1282.zh: 小松鼠拖着一条大尾巴在树枝间跳跃。
1282.py: Xiǎo sōng shǔ tuō zhe yī tiáo dà wěi ba zài shù zhī jiān tiào yuè.
1282.en: The squirrel hops among tree branches dragging a big tail.

1283.zh: 新学期的升旗仪式在操场上隆重举行。
1283.py: Xīn xué qī de shēng qí yí shì zài cāo chǎng shàng lóng zhòng jǔ xíng.
1283.en: The flag-raising ceremony of new semester was held on sports ground.

1284.zh: 我们要从小养成诚实美德，绝不可偷盗。
1284.py: Wǒ men yào cóng xiǎo yǎng chéng chéng shí měi dé, jué bù kě tōu dào.
1284.en: We should form the virtue of honesty from childhood, never stealing.

1285.zh: 一群活泼的骏马在广阔草原上奔跑。
1285.py: Yī qún huó pō de jùn mǎ zài guǎng kuò cǎo yuán shàng bēn pǎo.
1285.en: A group of lively steeds galloped across the vast grassland.

1286.zh: 清晨晶莹的露珠静静挂在花瓣上面。
1286.py: Qīng chén jīng yíng de lù zhū jìng jìng guà zài huā bàn shàng miàn.
1286.en: Crystal dewdrops in early morning hung quietly on petals.

1287.zh: 春天到了，草丛里的小昆虫苏醒了。
1287.py: Chūn tiān dào le, cǎo cóng lǐ de xiǎo kūn chóng sū xǐng le.
1287.en: Spring has arrived, and little insects in the grass have awakened.

1288.zh: 一支医疗救援队伍长期进驻山区看病。
1288.py: Yī zhī yī liáo jiù yuán duì wǔ cháng qī jìn zhù shān qū kàn bìng.
1288.en: A medical rescue team stationed in the mountains to treat diseases.

1289.zh: 孔子是中国古代伟大的教育家与先师。
1289.py: Kǒng zi shì zhōng guó gǔ dài wěi dà de jiào yù jiā yǔ xiān shī.
1289.en: Confucius was a great educator and teacher in ancient China.

1290.zh: 今天天气晴朗和煦，非常适宜去郊游。
1290.py: Jīn tiān tiān qì qíng lǎng hé xù, fēi cháng shì yí qù jiāo yóu.
1290.en: Today's weather is sunny and warm, very suitable for an outing.

1291.zh: 端午节时，家家户户在门旁悬挂艾草。
1291.py: Duān wǔ jié shí, jiā jiā hù hù zài mén páng xuán guà ài cǎo.
1291.en: During Dragon Boat Festival, households hang mugwort by doors.

1292.zh: 一座古老坚固的石拱桥横跨在小河上。
1292.py: Yī zuò gǔ lǎo jiān gù de shí gǒng qiáo héng kuà zài xiǎo hé shàng.
1292.en: An ancient sturdy stone arch bridge spans across the small river.

1293.zh: 做菜时少放盐，清淡饮食有益身体健康。
1293.py: Zuò cài shí shǎo fàng yán, qīng dàn yǐn shí yǒu yì shēn tǐ jiàn kāng.
1293.en: Put less salt when cooking; a light diet benefits health.

1294.zh: 做化学实验操作时一定要小心翼翼。
1294.py: Zuò huà xué shí yàn cāo zuò shí yí dìng yào xiǎo xīn yì yì.
1294.en: Be cautious and careful when doing chemistry experiments.

1295.zh: 我们要学会宽容他人，不要心怀仇恨。
1295.py: Wǒ men yào xué huì kuān róng tā rén, bú yào xīn huái chóu hèn.
1295.en: We should learn to forgive others, not harboring hatred in heart.

1296.zh: 春天到了，公园里的花朵开得非常繁茂。
1296.py: Chūn tiān dào le, gōng yuán lǐ de huā duǒ kāi de fēi cháng fán mào.
1296.en: Spring has arrived, flowers in the park bloom very luxuriantly.

1297.zh: 寒冬腊月里，多喝一杯温水暖暖身子。
1297.py: Hán dōng là yuè lǐ, duō hē yī bēi wēn shuǐ nuǎn nuǎn shēn zi.
1297.en: In cold winter, drink an extra cup of warm water to warm the body.

1298.zh: 经典图书是成长道路上最忠实的好伴侣。
1298.py: Jīng diǎn tú shū shì chéng zhǎng dào lù shàng zuì zhōng shí de hǎo bàn lǚ.
1298.en: Classic books are the most faithful companions on growth road.

1299.zh: 黄山奇峰怪石的景观让人由衷赞叹。
1299.py: Huáng shān qí fēng guài shí de jǐng guān ràng rén yóu zhōng zàn tàn.
1299.en: The scenery of Huangshan's unique rocks makes people marvel sincerely.

1300.zh: 每年的元旦节是标志新一年开始的节日。
1300.py: Měi nián de yuán dàn jié shì biāo zhì xīn yī nián kāi shǐ de jié rì.
1300.en: New Year's Day each year is a festival marking start of new year.

1301.zh: 经过治疗，他的感冒已经完全痊愈了。
1301.py: Jīng guò zhì liáo, tā de gǎn mào yǐ jīng wán quán quán yù le.
1301.en: After treatment, his cold has fully recovered.

1302.zh: 海边的空气非常湿润，潮气很大。
1302.py: Hǎi biān de kōng qì fēi cháng shī rùn, cháo qì hěn dà.
1302.en: The air by the sea is very moist and humid.

1303.zh: 农民伯伯辛勤劳动生产出充足的粮食。
1303.py: Nóng mín bó bo xīn qín láo dòng shēng chǎn chū chōng zú de liáng shí.
1303.en: Farmers work hard to produce sufficient grain.

1304.zh: 这件毛衣洗过后稍微收缩了一点点。
1304.py: Zhè jiàn máo yī xǐ guò hòu shāo wēi shōu suō le yì diǎn diǎn.
1304.en: This sweater shrank a little bit after washing.

1305.zh: 下课铃响了，大家罢笔走出教室休息。
1305.py: Xià kè líng xiǎng le, dà jiā bà bǐ zǒu chū jiào shì xiū xī.
1305.en: The class bell rang, everyone stopped writing and walked out to rest.

1306.zh: 周末许多好朋友聚在一起开心地聊天。
1306.py: Zhōu mò xǔ duō hǎo péng yǒu jù zài yì qǐ kāi xīn de liáo tiān.
1306.en: Many good friends gather together on weekends to chat happily.

1307.zh: 公园里有一条美丽的绿树林荫小径。
1307.py: Gōng yuán lǐ yǒu yī tiáo měi lì de lǜ shù lín yīn xiǎo jìng.
1307.en: There is a beautiful tree-lined path in the park.

1308.zh: 这件新衣服穿在你身上恰好合适好看。
1308.py: Zhè jiàn xīn yī fú chuān zài nǐ shēn shàng qià hǎo hé shì hǎo kàn.
1308.en: This new clothing suits you just right, looking pretty.

1309.zh: 我们在水果超市里精心挑选新鲜苹果。
1309.py: Wǒ men zài shuǐ guǒ chāo shì lǐ jīng xīn tiāo xuǎn xīn xiān píng guǒ.
1309.en: We carefully pick fresh apples in the fruit supermarket.

1310.zh: 请大家出门购物时自觉带上环保布袋。
1310.py: Qǐng dà jiā chū mén gòu wù shí zì jué dài shàng huán bǎo bù dài.
1310.en: Please bring eco-friendly cloth bags when going shopping.

1311.zh: 每天打扫房间时要把桌上的浮灰擦掉。
1311.py: Měi tiān dǎ sǎo fáng jiān shí yào bǎ zhuō shàng de fú huī cā diào.
1311.en: Wipe off floating dust on desk when cleaning room daily.

1312.zh: 渔民大清早出海捕捞新鲜的水产鱼虾。
1312.py: Yú mín dà qīng zǎo chū hǎi bǔ lāo xīn xiān de shuǐ chǎn yú xiā.
1312.en: Fishermen go out to sea at dawn to catch fresh fish and shrimp.

1313.zh: 春风徐徐吹过，让人感觉非常舒服。
1313.py: Chūn fēng xú xú chuī guò, ràng rén gǎn jué fēi cháng shū fú.
1313.en: The spring breeze blew gently, making one feel very comfortable.

1314.zh: 时间非常宝贵，我们要格外珍惜光阴。
1314.py: Shí jiān fēi cháng bǎo guì, wǒ men yào gé wài zhēn xī guāng yīn.
1314.en: Time is very precious, we should cherish time especially.

1315.zh: 精彩的话剧表演拉下了闭幕大幕布。
1315.py: Jīng cǎi de huà jù biǎo yǎn lā xià le bì mù dà mù bù.
1315.en: The wonderful drama performance drew down the curtain.

1316.zh: 绿树红花倒映在清澈见底的湖水里。
1316.py: Lǜ shù hóng huā dào yìng zài qīng chè jiàn dǐ de hú shuǐ lǐ.
1316.en: Green trees and red flowers reflected in clear lake water.

1317.zh: 冬天天气干燥，皮肤容易发生干裂。
1317.py: Dōng tiān tiān qì gān zào, pí fū róng yì fā shēng gān liè.
1317.en: Weather is dry in winter, skin easily develops chapping.

1318.zh: 泰山是中国著名的五岳名山之首座。
1318.py: Tài shān shì zhōng guó zhù míng de wǔ yuè míng shān zhī shǒu zuò.
1318.en: Mount Tai is the chief of China's famous Five Great Mountains.

1319.zh: 虽然远隔千里，但我们依然是好朋友。
1319.py: Suī rán yuǎn gé qiān lǐ, dàn wǒ men yī rán shì hǎo péng yǒu.
1319.en: Although separated by thousands of miles, we are still good friends.

1320.zh: 多读优秀好书能开启智慧启发思考。
1320.py: Duō dú yōu xiù hǎo shū néng kāi qǐ zhì huì qǐ fā sī kǎo.
1320.en: Reading good books can open wisdom and inspire thinking.

1321.zh: 这支新铅笔削得非常尖锐，很好写字。
1321.py: Zhè zhī xīn qiān bǐ xuē de fēi cháng jiān ruì, hěn hǎo xiě zì.
1321.en: This new pencil is sharpened very sharp, very easy to write.

1322.zh: 岳飞是一位忠诚爱国的古代著名名将。
1322.py: Yuè fēi shì yī wèi zhōng chéng ài guó de gǔ dài zhù míng míng jiàng.
1322.en: Yue Fei was a loyal and patriotic famous general in ancient times.

1323.zh: 打完篮球虽然感觉身体累，但很开心。
1323.py: Dǎ wán lán qiú suī rán gǎn jué shēn tǐ lèi, dàn hěn kāi xīn.
1323.en: Although feeling tired after basketball, I'm very happy.

1324.zh: 夏天的天气炎热，要多喝温水防暑。
1324.py: Xià tiān de tiān qì yán rè, yào duō hē wēn shuǐ fáng shǔ.
1324.en: Summer weather is hot, drink more warm water to prevent heatstroke.

1325.zh: 外面下大雨了，我们在亭子里暂时避雨。
1325.py: Wài miàn xià dà yǔ le, wǒ men zài tíng zi lǐ zàn shí bì yǔ.
1325.en: It is raining heavily, we temporarily shelter from rain in pavilion.

1326.zh: 老师对大家的考试成绩做出了客观评估。
1326.py: Lǎo shī duì dà jiā de kǎo shì chéng jì zuò chū le kè guān píng gū.
1326.en: The teacher made an objective assessment of everyone's exam results.

1327.zh: 广泛阅读有益书籍能有效开阔视野。
1327.py: Guǎng fàn yuè dú yǒu yì shū jí néng yǒu xiào kāi kuò shì yě.
1327.en: Reading beneficial books extensively can broaden horizons effectively.

1328.zh: 经过辛勤开垦，昔日荒地变成了良田。
1328.py: Jīng guò xīn qín kāi kěn, xī rì huāng de biàn chéng le liáng tián.
1328.en: Through reclamation, former wasteland turned into fertile farmland.

1329.zh: 弄坏了别人的东西要主动承认并赔偿。
1329.py: Nòng huài le bié rén de dōng xī yào zhǔ dòng chéng rèn bìng péi cháng.
1329.en: If you break someone else's thing, admit and compensate actively.

1330.zh: 过马路时必须走安全的人行横道线。
1330.py: Guò mǎ lù shí bì xū zǒu ān quán de rén xíng héng dào xiàn.
1330.en: Must walk on safe pedestrian crosswalks when crossing the street.

1331.zh: 我们要坚决拒绝一切不良诱惑与坏习惯。
1331.py: Wǒ men yào jiān jué jù jué yī qiè bù liáng yòu huò yǔ huài xí guàn.
1331.en: We must resolutely reject all bad temptations and bad habits.

1332.zh: 瑞雪兆丰年，冬天下雪预示着好收成。
1332.py: Ruì xuě zhào fēng nián, dōng tiān xià xuě yù shì zhe hǎo shōu chéng.
1332.en: Timely snow foretells a bumper year; winter snow portends good harvest.

1333.zh: 翻看老照片唤起了许多美好的童年回忆。
1333.py: Fān kàn lǎo zhào piān huàn qǐ le xǔ duō měi hǎo de tóng nián huí yì.
1333.en: Looking at old photos aroused many wonderful childhood memories.

1334.zh: 全社会都应当热心关爱身边的孤寡老人。
1334.py: Quán shè huì dōu yīng dāng rè xīn guān ài shēn biān de gū guǎ lǎo rén.
1334.en: The whole society should warmly care for solitary elderly people.

1335.zh: 感冒鼻塞不舒服时要多喝热水休息。
1335.py: Gǎn mào bí sè bù shū fú shí yào duō hē rè shuǐ xiū xī.
1335.en: Drink more hot water and rest when having a cold and stuffy nose.

1336.zh: 早晨的菜市场里人来人往，非常热闹。
1336.py: Zǎo chén de cài shì chǎng lǐ rén lái rén wǎng, fēi cháng rè nào.
1336.en: People come and go in morning vegetable market, very lively.

1337.zh: 草地上有一群可爱温顺的小白羊吃草。
1337.py: Cǎo dì shàng yǒu yī qún kě ài wēn shùn de xiǎo bái yáng chī cǎo.
1337.en: There is a flock of cute, gentle little white sheep eating grass.

1338.zh: 听到这个突如其来的好消息，他呆住了。
1338.py: Tīng dào zhè ge tū rú qí lái de hǎo xiāo xī, tā dāi zhù le.
1338.en: Hearing this sudden good news, he was so surprised that he froze.

1339.zh: 王老师平时对我们的学业要求比较严厉。
1339.py: Wáng lǎo shī píng shí duì wǒ men de xué yè yāo qiú bǐ jiào yán lì.
1339.en: Teacher Wang usually has comparatively strict demands on our study.

1340.zh: 合理均衡的三餐饮食对身体健康很重要。
1340.py: Hé lǐ jūn héng de sān cān yǐn shí duì shēn tǐ jiàn kāng hěn zhòng yào.
1340.en: A reasonably balanced diet of three meals is important for health.

1341.zh: 海内外的中华同胞都是相亲相爱一家人。
1341.py: Hǎi nèi wài de zhōng huá tóng bāo dōu shì xiāng qīn xiāng ài yī jiā rén.
1341.en: Chinese compatriots at home and abroad are all one loving family.

1342.zh: 今天冬天的最低气温降到了零下五度。
1342.py: Jīn tiān dōng tiān de zuì dī qì wēn jiàng dào le líng xià wǔ dù.
1342.en: The lowest temperature this winter dropped to five degrees below zero.

1343.zh: 通过努力读书可以摆脱贫穷过上好生活。
1343.py: Tōng guò nǔ lì dú shū kě yǐ bǎi tuō pín qióng guò shàng hǎo shēng huó.
1343.en: Through studying hard one can get rid of poverty and live a good life.

1344.zh: 大学宿舍里的同班同学们相处得很融洽。
1344.py: Dà xué sù shè lǐ de tóng bān tóng xué men xiāng chǔ de hěn róng qià.
1344.en: Classmates in university dormitory get along very harmoniously.

1345.zh: 乘坐公共交通时请提前准备好乘车码。
1345.py: Chéng zuò gōng gòng jiāo tōng shí qǐng tí qián zhǔn bèi hǎo chéng chē mǎ.
1345.en: Please prepare the transit code in advance when taking public transport.

1346.zh: 爱因斯坦是世界上享有赫赫盛名的科学家。
1346.py: Ài yīn sī tǎn shì shì jiè shàng xiǎng yǒu hè hè shèng míng de kē xué jiā.
1346.en: Einstein is a scientist enjoying great fame in the world.

1347.zh: 外婆做的鲜肉大馄饨特别香甜可口好吃。
1347.py: Wài pó zuò de xiān ròu dà hún tún tè bié xiāng tián kě kǒu hǎo chī.
1347.en: The fresh meat wontons made by maternal grandmother are delicious.

1348.zh: 爱国主义精神是中华民族伟大的民族之魂。
1348.py: Ài guó zhǔ yì jīng shén shì zhōng huá mín zú wěi dà de mín zú zhī hún.
1348.en: Patriotic spirit is the great national soul of the Chinese nation.

1349.zh: 遇到火灾时要用湿毛巾捂住口鼻迅速逃生。
1349.py: Yù dào huǒ zāi shí yào yòng shī máo jīn wǔ zhù kǒu bí xùn sù táo shēng.
1349.en: When meeting a fire, cover nose and mouth with wet towels to escape.

1350.zh: 修建水利大坝能有效防范大江大河的洪灾。
1350.py: Xiū jiàn shuǐ lì dà bà néng yǒu xiào fáng fàn dà jiāng dà hé de hóng zāi.
1350.en: Building water conservancy dams can prevent flood disasters of rivers.

1351.zh: 每天坚持慢跑锻炼能增强双腿的力量。
1351.py: Měi tiān jiān chí màn pǎo duàn liàn néng zēng qiáng shuāng tuǐ de lì liàng.
1351.en: Persisting in jogging every day can enhance the strength of legs.

1352.zh: 青年人要大胆走上讲台发表自己的观点。
1352.py: Qīng nián rén yào dà dǎn zǒu shàng jiǎng tái fā biǎo zì jǐ de guān diǎn.
1352.en: Young people should boldly step onto the podium to express views.

1353.zh: 天津是一座依河傍海的北方著名大城市。
1353.py: Tiān jīn shì yī zuò yī hé bàng hǎi de běi fāng zhù míng dà chéng shì.
1353.en: Tianjin is a famous large northern city by rivers and sea.

1354.zh: 过年贴春联是中国传统民间重要风俗。
1354.py: Guò nián tiē chūn lián shì zhōng guó chuán tǒng mín jiān zhòng yào fēng sú.
1354.en: Pasting couplets during New Year is an important folk custom in China.

1355.zh: 正反双方在辩论赛上的辩论非常精彩。
1355.py: Zhèng fǎn shuāng fāng zài biàn lùn sài shàng de biàn lùn fēi cháng jīng cǎi.
1355.en: The debate between affirmative and negative sides was very wonderful.

1356.zh: 做人要有宽广的胸怀，学会包容他人。
1356.py: Zuò rén yào yǒu kuān guǎng de xiōng huái, xué huì bāo róng tā rén.
1356.en: In conduct have a broad mind and learn to tolerate others.

1357.zh: 这首描写春雨的优美古诗在民间家喻户晓。
1357.py: Zhè shǒu miáo xiě chūn yǔ de yōu měi gǔ shī zài mín jiān jiā yù hù xiǎo.
1357.en: This ancient poem describing spring rain is known to all households.

1358.zh: 大家心往一处想、劲往一处使就能成功。
1358.py: Dà jiā xīn wǎng yī chù xiǎng, jìn wǎng yī chù shǐ jiù néng chéng gōng.
1358.en: Everyone thinks with one heart and exerts effort together to succeed.

1359.zh: 国家大力支持贫困地区的乡村教育发展。
1359.py: Guó jiā dà lì zhī chí pín kùn de qū de xiāng cūn jiào yù fā zhǎn.
1359.en: The state vigorously supports rural education development in poor areas.

1360.zh: 我们要常怀一颗善良仁爱的心去对待他人。
1360.py: Wǒ men yào cháng huái yī kē shàn liáng rén ài de xīn qù duì dài tā rén.
1360.en: We should always have a kind and benevolent heart to treat others.

1361.zh: 在去图书馆的路上，我偶然遇到了老朋友。
1361.py: Zài qù tú shū guǎn de lù shàng, wǒ ǒu rán yù dào le lǎo péng yǒu.
1361.en: On the way to the library, I ran into an old friend by chance.

1362.zh: 老师向大家详细讲解了这道题的解题逻辑。
1362.py: Lǎo shī xiàng dà jiā xiáng xì jiǎng jiě le zhè dào tí de jiě tí luó jí.
1362.en: The teacher explained the problem-solving logic of this question in detail.

1363.zh: 中国自古以来就是一个著名的礼仪之邦。
1363.py: Zhōng guó zì gǔ yǐ lái jiù shì yí gè zhù míng de lǐ yí zhī bāng.
1363.en: China has been a famous land of etiquette since ancient times.

1364.zh: 经过充分休息，他的体力已经恢复正常了。
1364.py: Jīng guò chōng fèn xiū xī, tā de tǐ lì yǐ jīng huī fù zhèng cháng le.
1364.en: After full rest, his physical energy has recovered to normal.

1365.zh: 我们要学会独立自强，切不可过度依赖父母。
1365.py: Wǒ men yào xué huì dú lì zì qiáng, qiè bù kě guò dù yī lài fù mǔ.
1365.en: We should learn to be independent, never relying excessively on parents.

1366.zh: 体育老师带领全班同学在操场上跑了两圈。
1366.py: Tǐ yù lǎo shī dài lǐng quán bān tóng xué zài cāo chǎng shàng pǎo le liǎng quān.
1366.en: The PE teacher led the whole class to run two laps on the playground.

1367.zh: 他伸出手轻轻抚摸了一下小花猫的毛发。
1367.py: Tā shēn chū shǒu qīng qīng fǔ mō le yī xià xiǎo huā māo de máo fà.
1367.en: He reached out and stroked the little cat's fur gently.

1368.zh: 站在山顶仰望浩瀚夜空，繁星闪烁很美丽。
1368.py: Zhàn zài shān dǐng yǎng wàng hào hàn yè kōng, fán xīng shǎn shuò hěn měi lì.
1368.en: Standing on the mountain looking up at night sky, stars sparkle nicely.

1369.zh: 清晨的细雨悄悄滋润着原野上的绿草地。
1369.py: Qīng chén de xì yǔ qiāo qiāo zī rùn zhe yuán yě shàng de lǜ cǎo dì.
1369.en: The fine morning rain quietly moistens the green grass on the fields.

1370.zh: 书桌上整齐地堆放着几本厚厚的专业书籍。
1370.py: Shū zhuō shàng zhěng qí de duī fàng zhe jǐ běn hòu hòu de zhuān yè shū jí.
1370.en: Several thick professional books are neatly piled on the desk.

1371.zh: 走路时看手机容易不小心碰到路边的行人。
1371.py: Zǒu lù shí kàn shǒu jī róng yì bù xiǎo xīn pèng dào lù biān de xíng rén.
1371.en: Looking at phones while walking easily bumps into pedestrians by accident.

1372.zh: 一艘白色快艇在平静蔚蓝的海面上疾驰。
1372.py: Yī sōu bái sè kuài tǐng zài píng jìng wèi lán de hǎi miàn shàng jí chí.
1372.en: A white speedboat sped across the calm and blue sea surface.

1373.zh: 请大家在教室门口稍等片刻，老师马上来。
1373.py: Qǐng dà jiā zài jiào shì mén kǒu shāo děng piàn kè, lǎo shī mǎ shàng lái.
1373.en: Please wait a moment at the classroom door, the teacher comes right away.

1374.zh: 出门前要合理规划好时间，避免上学迟到。
1374.py: Chū mén qián yào hé lǐ guī huà hǎo shí jiān, bì miǎn shàng xué chí dào.
1374.en: Plan time reasonably before going out to avoid being late for school.

1375.zh: 校门口停着一辆干净的新公交车。
1375.py: Xiào mén kǒu tíng zhe yī liàng gān jìng de xīn gōng jiāo chē.
1375.en: A clean new bus is parked at the school gate.

1376.zh: 我们要树立环保意识，分类回收废旧物品。
1376.py: Wǒ men yào shù lì huán bǎo yì shí, fēn lèi huí shōu fèi jiù wù pǐn.
1376.en: We should establish eco-awareness and sort recyclable waste items.

1377.zh: 同学们把整间教室打扫得干干净净。
1377.py: Tóng xué men bǎ zhěng jiān jiào shì dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng.
1377.en: Students cleaned the whole classroom clean and tidy.

1378.zh: 在野外遇到凶猛的野兽时一定要保持冷静。
1378.py: Zài yě wài yù dào xiōng měng de yě shòu shí yí dìng yào bǎo chí lěng jìng.
1378.en: Keep calm when encountering ferocious wild beasts in the wild.

1379.zh: 相关政府部门做好了防汛工作的全面部署。
1379.py: Xiāng guān zhèng fǔ bù mén zuò hǎo le fáng xùn gōng zuò de quán miàn bù shǔ.
1379.en: Relevant government departments made deployments for flood control work.

1380.zh: 房间的白色墙壁上挂着一幅美丽的中国画。
1380.py: Fáng jiān de bái sè qiáng bì shàng guà zhe yī fú měi lì de zhōng guó huà.
1380.en: A beautiful Chinese painting hangs on the white wall of the room.

1381.zh: 冬天穿上厚羽绒服能有效抵御室外的严寒。
1381.py: Dōng tiān chuān shàng hòu yǔ róng fú néng yǒu xiào dǐ yù shì wài de yán hán.
1381.en: Wearing a thick down jacket in winter can resist outdoor bitter cold.

1382.zh: 医护人员在岗位上默默奉献爱心。
1382.py: Yī hù rén yuán zài gǎng wèi shàng mò mò fèng xiàn ài xīn.
1382.en: Medical staff dedicate love quietly at working posts.

1383.zh: 金黄的落叶在微风中打着旋转儿飘落下来。
1383.py: Jīn huáng de luò yè zài wēi fēng zhōng dǎ zhe xuán zhuǎn ér piāo luò xià lái.
1383.en: Golden fallen leaves spun and drifted down in the breeze.

1384.zh: 冬天到了，树枝上和屋顶上落满了洁白雪花。
1384.py: Dōng tiān dào le, shù zhī shàng hé wū dǐng shàng luò mǎn le jié bái xuě huā.
1384.en: Winter has arrived, and white snowflakes covered branches and rooftops.

1385.zh: 大山深处蕴藏着丰富的煤炭和铁矿。
1385.py: Dà shān shēn chù yùn cáng zhe fēng fù de méi tàn hé tiě kuàng.
1385.en: Rich coal and iron ore are buried deep in the mountains.

1386.zh: 遇到不懂的问题时，同学们自信地抬起头来。
1386.py: Yù dào bù dǒng de wèn tí shí, tóng xué men zì xìn de tái qǐ tóu lái.
1386.en: When meeting difficult questions, students raised their heads confidently.

1387.zh: 早餐吃一个水煮鸡蛋能补充营养。
1387.py: Zǎo cān chī yí gè shuǐ zhǔ jī dàn néng bǔ chōng yíng yǎng.
1387.en: Eating a boiled egg for breakfast replenishes nutrition.

1388.zh: 每天清晨他都迎着朝阳在湖边跑步。
1388.py: Měi tiān qīng chén tā dōu yíng zhe zhāo yáng zài hú biān pǎo bù.
1388.en: He runs by the lake facing the morning sun every early morning.

1389.zh: 炎热的三伏天里要多喝温开水防暑降温。
1389.py: Yán rè de sān fú tiān lǐ yào duō hē wēn kāi shuǐ fáng shǔ jiàng wēn.
1389.en: Drink more warm water in hot dog days to prevent heatstroke.

1390.zh: 春风轻柔地吹拂着清澈湖边的翠绿柳枝条。
1390.py: Chūn fēng qīng róu de chuī fú zhe qīng chè hú biān de cuì lǜ liǔ zhī tiáo.
1390.en: Spring breeze softly brushed green willow branches by the clear lake.

1391.zh: 清晨村子里传来了大公鸡的鸣叫声。
1391.py: Qīng chén cūn zi lǐ chuán lái le dà gōng jī de míng jiào shēng.
1391.en: Crows of the rooster came from the village in early morning.

1392.zh: 经过科学复习，他的学习效率提升了一倍。
1392.py: Jīng guò kē xué fù xí, tā de xué xí xiào lǜ tí shēng le yí bèi.
1392.en: Through scientific review, his learning efficiency improved twofold.

1393.zh: 做题时要把概念理解清楚，切不可模糊混乱。
1393.py: Zuò tí shí yào bǎ gài niàn lǐ jiě qīng chǔ, qiè bù kě mó hú hùn luàn.
1393.en: Understand concepts clearly when doing exercises, never be fuzzy.

1394.zh: 秦始皇兵马俑是著名的古代奇迹。
1394.py: Qín shǐ huáng bīng mǎ yǒng shì zhù míng de gǔ dài qí jì.
1394.en: Terracotta Army of Qin is a famous ancient miracle.

1395.zh: 同学之间发生摩擦时要互谅互让，化解矛盾。
1395.py: Tóng xué zhī jiān fā shēng mó cā shí yào hù liàng hù ràng, huà jiě máo dùn.
1395.en: When friction occurs among classmates, show understanding to resolve conflicts.

1396.zh: 运动过后喝一杯温水能迅速补水。
1396.py: Yùn dòng guò hòu hē yī bēi wēn shuǐ néng xùn sù bǔ shuǐ.
1396.en: Drinking a cup of warm water after exercise replenishes water quickly.

1397.zh: 他在学校附近租了一间安静的公寓。
1397.py: Tā zài xué xiào fù jìn zū le yī jiān ān jìng de gōng yù.
1397.en: He rented a quiet apartment near the school.

1398.zh: 骑自行车上下学既环保又能锻炼。
1398.py: Qí zì xíng chē shàng xià xué jì huán bǎo yòu néng duàn liàn.
1398.en: Riding a bicycle to school is eco-friendly and exercises.

1399.zh: 长途跋涉之后身体感到困乏，坐下好好休息。
1399.py: Cháng tú bá shè zhī hòu shēn tǐ gǎn dào kùn fá, zuò xià hǎo hǎo xiū xī.
1399.en: Body feels tired after a long journey; sit down and rest well.

1400.zh: 全校师生在礼堂里隆重举行典礼。
1400.py: Quán xiào shī shēng zài lǐ táng lǐ lóng zhòng jǔ xíng diǎn lǐ.
1400.en: Teachers and students held ceremony grandly in auditorium.

1401.zh: 医生正在耐心地为病人诊断身体病情。
1401.py: Yī shēng zhèng zài nài xīn de wèi bìng rén zhěn duàn shēn tǐ bìng qíng.
1401.en: The doctor is patiently diagnosing the patient's condition.

1402.zh: 我们要坚决反对残酷的奴隶制度。
1402.py: Wǒ men yào jiān jué fǎn duì cán kù de nú lì zhì dù.
1402.en: We must resolutely oppose the cruel slavery system.

1403.zh: 每天摄入充足的新鲜蔬菜对健康有益。
1403.py: Měi tiān shè rù chōng zú de xīn xiān shū cài duì jiàn kāng yǒu yì.
1403.en: Intaking adequate fresh vegetables daily is beneficial to health.

1404.zh: 遇到挫折时千万不要灰心丧气。
1404.py: Yù dào cuò zhé shí qiān wàn bú yào huī xīn sàng qì.
1404.en: Never be disheartened when meeting setbacks.

1405.zh: 我们要共同保护环境，减少污水排放。
1405.py: Wǒ men yào gòng tóng bǎo hù huán jìng, jiǎn shǎo wū shuǐ pái fàng.
1405.en: We should jointly protect the environment and reduce sewage discharge.

1406.zh: 一艘小客船正缓缓摆渡过宽阔大江。
1406.py: Yī sōu xiǎo kè chuán zhèng huǎn huǎn bǎi dù guò kuān kuò dà jiāng.
1406.en: A small passenger boat is slowly ferrying across the wide river.

1407.zh: 五星红旗在校园操场上空迎风飘扬。
1407.py: Wǔ xīng hóng qí zài xiào yuán cāo chǎng shàng kōng yíng fēng piāo yáng.
1407.en: The five-star red flag flutters in the wind over the school playground.

1408.zh: 山里流淌着甘甜清凉的天然泉水。
1408.py: Shān lǐ liú tǎng zhe gān tián qīng liáng de tiān rán quán shuǐ.
1408.en: Sweet and cool natural spring water flows in the mountains.

1409.zh: 老师耐心地向同学们讲解了这道难题。
1409.py: Lǎo shī nài xīn de xiàng tóng xué men jiǎng jiě le zhè dào nán tí.
1409.en: The teacher patiently explained this difficult problem to students.

1410.zh: 他凭着坚持不懈的努力取得了优异成绩。
1410.py: Tā píng zhe jiān chí bù xiè de nǔ lì qǔ de le yōu yì chéng jì.
1410.en: He achieved excellent results by virtue of persistent efforts.

1411.zh: 小姑娘头上扎着两条漂亮的辫子。
1411.py: Xiǎo gū niáng tóu shàng zhā zhe liǎng tiáo piào liàng de biàn zi.
1411.en: The little girl tied two pretty braids on her head.

1412.zh: 过马路要走斑马线，切不可抢道。
1412.py: Guò mǎ lù yào zǒu bān mǎ xiàn, qiè bù kě qiǎng dào.
1412.en: Walk on crosswalks when crossing street, never rush.

1413.zh: 遇到急事要学会平复自己紧张的情绪。
1413.py: Yù dào jí shì yào xué huì píng fù zì jǐ jǐn zhāng de qíng xù.
1413.en: Learn to calm your nervous emotions when meeting urgent matters.

1414.zh: 吃东西要细嚼慢咽，不要粗心大意。
1414.py: Chī dōng xī yào xì jiáo màn yàn, bú yào cū xīn dà yì.
1414.en: Chew food slowly when eating, do not be careless.

1415.zh: 我们要勇于承担肩上的责任与使命。
1415.py: Wǒ men yào yǒng yú chéng dān jiān shàng de zé rèn yǔ shǐ mìng.
1415.en: We should dare to shoulder responsibilities and missions on shoulders.

1416.zh: 桥梁横跨在波光粼粼的宽阔江面之上。
1416.py: Qiáo liáng héng kuà zài bō guāng lín lín de kuān kuò jiāng miàn zhī shàng.
1416.en: The bridge spans across the sparkling wide river surface.

1417.zh: 科学幻想激发了孩子们探索宇宙的兴趣。
1417.py: Kē xué huàn xiǎng jī fā le hái zi men tàn suǒ yǔ zhòu de xìng qù.
1417.en: Science fiction stimulated children's interest in exploring space.

1418.zh: 他在科技创新比赛中取得了不菲的成绩。
1418.py: Tā zài kē jì chuàng xīn bǐ sài zhōng qǔ de le bù fēi de chéng jì.
1418.en: He achieved considerable success in the innovation competition.

1419.zh: 全班同学皆按时完成了今天的家庭作业。
1419.py: Quán bān tóng xué jiē àn shí wán chéng le jīn tiān de jiā tíng zuò yè.
1419.en: All classmates finished today's homework on time.

1420.zh: 他不小心打碎了一个玻璃杯。
1420.py: Tā bù xiǎo xīn dǎ suì le yí gè bō lí bēi.
1420.en: He accidentally broke a glass cup.

1421.zh: 浩瀚的宇宙中藏着无数科学奥秘。
1421.py: Hào hàn de yǔ zhòu zhōng cáng zhe wú shù kē xué ào mì.
1421.en: Countless scientific mysteries are hidden in the vast universe.

1422.zh: 叔叔从外地出差回来，给我带了礼物。
1422.py: Shū shū cóng wài de chū chāi huí lái, gěi wǒ dài le lǐ wù.
1422.en: Uncle returned from a business trip and brought me a gift.

1423.zh: 登山队员在陡峭的岩石上小心攀登。
1423.py: Dēng shān duì yuán zài dǒu qiào de yán shí shàng xiǎo xīn pān dēng.
1423.en: Mountaineers climb carefully on the steep rocks.

1424.zh: 小船在碧波荡漾的清澈湖面上行驶。
1424.py: Xiǎo chuán zài bì bō dàng yàng de qīng chè hú miàn shàng xíng shǐ.
1424.en: The small boat sails on the clear lake surface with rippling blue waves.

1425.zh: 学校注重提升同学们的综合素质能力。
1425.py: Xué xiào zhù zhòng tí shēng tóng xué men de zōng hé sù zhì néng lì.
1425.en: The school focuses on improving students' comprehensive quality.

1426.zh: 周末我们全家一起去郊外爬山锻炼。
1426.py: Zhōu mò wǒ men quán jiā yì qǐ qù jiāo wài pá shān duàn liàn.
1426.en: Our whole family goes to the suburbs on weekends to climb mountains.

1427.zh: 夏天公园的池塘里盛开着美丽的粉荷花。
1427.py: Xià tiān gōng yuán de chí táng lǐ shèng kāi zhe měi lì de fěn hé huā.
1427.en: Beautiful pink lotus flowers bloom in the park pond in summer.

1428.zh: 经过一个学期的学习，大家熟悉了环境。
1428.py: Jīng guò yí gè xué qī de xué xí, dà jiā shú xī le huán jìng.
1428.en: After a semester of study, everyone became familiar with the environment.

1429.zh: 瓜熟蒂落，只要努力付出就会有收获。
1429.py: Guā shú dì luò, zhǐ yào nǔ lì fù chū jiù huì yǒu shōu huò.
1429.en: When melons are ripe they fall from stems; effort brings harvest.

1430.zh: 放学后同学们开开心心地返回了家里。
1430.py: Fàng xué hòu tóng xué men kāi kāi xīn xīn de fǎn huí le jiā lǐ.
1430.en: Students returned home happily after school.

1431.zh: 古老村庄中央有一口清澈的天然水井。
1431.py: Gǔ lǎo cūn zhuāng zhōng yāng yǒu yī kǒu qīng chè de tiān rán shuǐ jǐng.
1431.en: There is a clear natural water well in the center of the ancient village.

1432.zh: 泰山雄伟壮丽的日出景色令人难忘。
1432.py: Tài shān xióng wěi zhuàng lì de rì chū jǐng sè lìng rén nán wàng.
1432.en: Mount Tai's magnificent and majestic sunrise scenery is unforgettable.

1433.zh: 清晨湖面上结了一层薄薄的透明冰层。
1433.py: Qīng chén hú miàn shàng jié le yī céng báo báo de tòu míng bīng céng.
1433.en: A thin layer of transparent ice formed on the lake surface in morning.

1434.zh: 春天悄悄地来到了我们美丽的校园。
1434.py: Chūn tiān qiāo qiāo de lái dào le wǒ men měi lì de xiào yuán.
1434.en: Spring arrived quietly in our beautiful campus.

1435.zh: 同学们齐心协力把整座校园打扫干净。
1435.py: Tóng xué men qí xīn xié lì bǎ zhěng zuò xiào yuán dǎ sǎo gān jìng.
1435.en: Students worked together to sweep the whole campus clean.

1436.zh: 小花猫的动作非常灵敏敏捷矫健。
1436.py: Xiǎo huā māo de dòng zuò fēi cháng líng mǐn mǐn jié jiǎo jiàn.
1436.en: The little cat's movements are very agile and vigorous.

1437.zh: 只要坚持努力，就能克服各种学习障碍。
1437.py: Zhǐ yào jiān chí nǔ lì, jiù néng kè fú gè zhǒng xué xí zhàng ài.
1437.en: As long as you persist, you can overcome various learning obstacles.

1438.zh: 这片温暖的海域非常适合海产品养殖。
1438.py: Zhè piàn wēn nuǎn de hǎi yù fēi cháng shì hé hǎi chǎn pǐn yǎng zhí.
1438.en: This warm sea area is very suitable for seafood aquaculture.

1439.zh: 老师向大家详细解答了这道题。
1439.py: Lǎo shī xiàng dà jiā xiáng xì jiě dá le zhè dào tí.
1439.en: The teacher answered this question in detail for everyone.

1440.zh: 阅读经典文学能够启迪我们的智慧。
1440.py: Yuè dú jīng diǎn wén xué néng gòu qǐ dí wǒ men de zhì huì.
1440.en: Reading classic literature can enlighten our wisdom.

1441.zh: 他们通过友好沟通化解了矛盾。
1441.py: Tā men tōng guò yǒu hǎo gōu tōng huà jiě le máo dùn.
1441.en: They resolved contradictions through friendly communication.

1442.zh: 霍金是一位世界闻名的当代物理学家。
1442.py: Huò jīn shì yī wèi shì jiè wén míng dí dàng dài wù lǐ xué jiā.
1442.en: Hawking is a world-famous contemporary physicist.

1443.zh: 未经老师允许，不可随意离开教室。
1443.py: Wèi jīng lǎo shī yǔn xǔ, bù kě suí yì lí kāi jiào shì.
1443.en: Do not leave the classroom without the teacher's permission.

1444.zh: 美术馆里展出了一幅美丽的风景画。
1444.py: Měi shù guǎn lǐ zhǎn chū le yī fú měi lì de fēng jǐng huà.
1444.en: A beautiful landscape painting is displayed in the art gallery.

1445.zh: 春天农民在肥沃的农田里撒下麦种。
1445.py: Chūn tiān nóng mín zài féi wò de nóng tián lǐ sā xià mài zhǒng.
1445.en: Farmers scatter wheat seeds in fertile farmlands in spring.

1446.zh: 吃饭要适量，尽量不要剩饭菜。
1446.py: Chī fàn yào shì liàng, jǐn liàng bú yào shèng fàn cài.
1446.en: Eat appropriately, try not to leave leftover food.

1447.zh: 运动健儿们在比赛后凯旋归来受表扬。
1447.py: Yùn dòng jiàn ér men zài bǐ sài hòu kǎi xuán guī lái shòu biǎo yáng.
1447.en: Athletes returned triumphantly after the match and received praise.

1448.zh: 夜空中闪烁着一颗明亮耀眼的小星星。
1448.py: Yè kōng zhōng shǎn shuò zhe yī kē míng liàng yào yǎn de xiǎo xīng xīng.
1448.en: A bright and dazzling little star twinkles in the night sky.

1449.zh: 遇到摩擦要讲道理，绝不可开口骂人。
1449.py: Yù dào mó cā yào jiǎng dào lǐ, jué bù kě kāi kǒu mà rén.
1449.en: Reason through friction, never curse at people.

1450.zh: 春天我们全家一起去公园赏花拍照。
1450.py: Chūn tiān wǒ men quán jiā yì qǐ qù gōng yuán shǎng huā pāi zhào.
1450.en: Our family goes to the park to appreciate flowers and take photos in spring.

1451.zh: 人体每天需要摄入充足的液体水分。
1451.py: Rén tǐ měi tiān xū yào shè rù chōng zú de yè tǐ shuǐ fèn.
1451.en: The human body needs to intake adequate liquid water daily.

1452.zh: 经过一番努力，他终于通过了考试。
1452.py: Jīng guò yī fān nǔ lì, tā zhōng yú tōng guò le kǎo shì.
1452.en: After a period of effort, he finally passed the exam.

1453.zh: 把不常用的书籍整齐收进纸箱子里。
1453.py: Bǎ bù cháng yòng de shū jí zhěng qí shōu jìn zhǐ xiāng zi lǐ.
1453.en: Neatly pack infrequently used books into cardboard boxes.

1454.zh: 过年时家家户户都在大门上贴春联。
1454.py: Guò nián shí jiā jiā hù hù dōu zài dà mén shàng tiē chūn lián.
1454.en: Every household pastes couplets on the front door during New Year.

1455.zh: 夏日的傍晚在江边漫步非常舒适。
1455.py: Xià rì de bàng wǎn zài jiāng biān màn bù fēi cháng shū shì.
1455.en: Strolling by the river in summer evenings is very comfortable.

1456.zh: 新鲜的柠檬味道有点酸，但营养丰富。
1456.py: Xīn xiān de níng méng wèi dào yǒu diǎn suān, dàn yíng yǎng fēng fù.
1456.en: Fresh lemons taste a bit sour, but are rich in nutrition.

1457.zh: 那位年轻的新郎脸上挂满了幸福笑容。
1457.py: Nà wèi nián qīng de xīn láng liǎn shàng guà mǎn le xìng fú xiào róng.
1457.en: A happy smile hung on the face of that young groom.

1458.zh: 长时间坐着要适时伸展腰部。
1458.py: Zhǎng shí jiān zuò zhe yào shì shí shēn zhǎn yāo bù.
1458.en: Stretch your waist properly after sitting for a long time.

1459.zh: 这间向阳的卧室布置得非常舒适温馨。
1459.py: Zhè jiān xiàng yáng de wò shì bù zhì de fēi cháng shū shì wēn xīn.
1459.en: This sunny bedroom is arranged very comfortably and warmly.

1460.zh: 遇到难题时他习惯性地皱起眉头思考。
1460.py: Yù dào nán tí shí tā xí guàn xìng de zhòu qǐ méi tóu sī kǎo.
1460.en: He habitually knits his eyebrows in thought when meeting difficult problems.

1461.zh: 我们要学会放下不必要的担忧与烦恼。
1461.py: Wǒ men yào xué huì fàng xià bù bì yào de dān yōu yǔ fán nǎo.
1461.en: We should learn to put down unnecessary worries and troubles.

1462.zh: 几只白鸭子在平静的湖面上漂浮着。
1462.py: Jǐ zhī bái yā zi zài píng jìng de hú miàn shàng piāo fú zhe.
1462.en: Several white ducks are floating on the calm lake surface.

1463.zh: 我们要珍惜农民伯伯辛勤劳动的成果。
1463.py: Wǒ men yào zhēn xī nóng mín bó bo xīn qín láo dòng de chéng guǒ.
1463.en: We should cherish the fruits of farmers' hard labor.

1464.zh: 小孩子们十分留恋在游乐园里的时光。
1464.py: Xiǎo hái zi men shí fēn liú liàn zài yóu lè yuán lǐ de shí guāng.
1464.en: Little children are deeply attached to times in the amusement park.

1465.zh: 学校食堂为大家提供营养美味的一日三餐。
1465.py: Xué xiào shí táng wèi dà jiā tí gōng yíng yǎng měi wèi de yī rì sān cān.
1465.en: The school canteen provides nutritious, delicious three meals daily.

1466.zh: 突然关门的巨大响声吓了他一跳。
1466.py: Tū rán guān mén de jù dà xiǎng shēng xià le tā yī tiào.
1466.en: The loud sound of the door closing suddenly startled him.

1467.zh: 军训时同学们把腰杆挺得直直的。
1467.py: Jūn xùn shí tóng xué men bǎ yāo gǎn tǐng de zhí zhí de.
1467.en: Students held their backs straight up during military training.

1468.zh: 老师温暖的鼓励激发了大家的学习热情。
1468.py: Lǎo shī wēn nuǎn de gǔ lì jī fā le dà jiā de xué xí rè qíng.
1468.en: The teacher's warm encouragement stimulated everyone's study enthusiasm.

1469.zh: 毕业典礼上学生代表发表了致辞。
1469.py: Bì yè diǎn lǐ shàng xué shēng dài biǎo fā biǎo le zhì cí.
1469.en: The student representative delivered a speech at graduation.

1470.zh: 一艘巨大的远洋货轮正缓缓驶离港口。
1470.py: Yī sōu jù dà de yuǎn yáng huò lún zhèng huǎn huǎn shǐ lí gǎng kǒu.
1470.en: A huge ocean cargo ship is slowly sailing away from the harbor.

1471.zh: 电脑键盘上的回车键非常常用。
1471.py: Diàn nǎo jiàn pán shàng de huí chē jiàn fēi cháng cháng yòng.
1471.en: The Enter key on the computer keyboard is very commonly used.

1472.zh: 青年志愿者队伍为社区提供了热心服务。
1472.py: Qīng nián zhì yuàn zhě duì wǔ wèi shè qū tí gōng le rè xīn fú wù.
1472.en: The youth volunteer team provided warm services for the community.

1473.zh: 登山队员们终于成功登上了大山山峰。
1473.py: Dēng shān duì yuán men zhōng yú chéng gōng dēng shàng le dà shān shān fēng.
1473.en: Mountaineers finally successfully summited the mountain peak.

1474.zh: 做几何图形作业时要用直尺画直线。
1474.py: Zuò jǐ hé tú xíng zuò yè shí yào yòng zhí chǐ huà zhí xiàn.
1474.en: Use a ruler to draw straight lines when doing geometry homework.

1475.zh: 昨天下午我们在操场上踢足球赛。
1475.py: Zuó tiān xià wǔ wǒ men zài cāo chǎng shàng tī zú qiú sài.
1475.en: Yesterday afternoon we played soccer on the playground.

1476.zh: 黎明时分天边泛起了一抹美丽的朝霞。
1476.py: Lí míng shí fēn tiān biān fàn qǐ le yī mǒ měi lì de zhāo xiá.
1476.en: At dawn a touch of beautiful morning glow appeared on the horizon.

1477.zh: 青年人应当向前辈学习优秀经验。
1477.py: Qīng nián rén yīng dāng xiàng qián bèi xué xí yōu xiù jīng yàn.
1477.en: Young people should learn good experience from predecessors.

1478.zh: 他一贯保持着认真完成作业的好习惯。
1478.py: Tā yí guàn bǎo chí zhe rèn zhēn wán chéng zuò yè de hǎo xí guàn.
1478.en: He consistently maintains the good habit of doing homework seriously.

1479.zh: 聪明的侦探很快找到了案件的关键线索。
1479.py: Cōng míng de zhēn tàn hěn kuài zhǎo dào le àn jiàn de guān jiàn xiàn suǒ.
1479.en: The clever detective quickly found the key clue of the case.

1480.zh: 冬天在结冰的地面上行走要防止滑倒。
1480.py: Dōng tiān zài jié bīng de de miàn shàng háng zǒu yào fáng zhǐ huá dào.
1480.en: Walk carefully on icy ground in winter to prevent slipping.

1481.zh: 超市今天向顾客发放了购物优惠券。
1481.py: Chāo shì jīn tiān xiàng gù kè fā fàng le gòu wù yōu huì quàn.
1481.en: The supermarket distributed shopping discount coupons to customers today.

1482.zh: 我们要崇尚科学真理，破除迷信观念。
1482.py: Wǒ men yào chóng shàng kē xué zhēn lǐ, pò chú mí xìn guān niàn.
1482.en: We must advocate scientific truth and eradicate superstitious concepts.

1483.zh: 在图书馆看书时请不要打扰他人。
1483.py: Zài tú shū guǎn kàn shū shí qǐng bú yào dǎ rǎo tā rén.
1483.en: Please do not disturb others when reading in library.

1484.zh: 宪法是国家的根本大法，效力最高。
1484.py: Xiàn fǎ shì guó jiā de gēn běn dà fǎ, xiào lì zuì gāo.
1484.en: The Constitution is the fundamental law of the state with highest effect.

1485.zh: 公园里有一条绕着小湖修建的慢跑绿道。
1485.py: Gōng yuán lǐ yǒu yī tiáo rào zhe xiǎo hú xiū jiàn de màn pǎo lǜ dào.
1485.en: There is a jogging greenway built winding around the lake in the park.

1486.zh: 现代生活正趋向智能化便捷化。
1486.py: Xiàn dài shēng huó zhèng qū xiàng zhì néng huà biàn jié huà.
1486.en: Modern life is tending towards intelligence and convenience.

1487.zh: 老奶奶脸上总是带着慈祥温和的笑容。
1487.py: Lǎo nǎi nǎi liǎn shàng zǒng shì dài zhe cí xiáng wēn hé de xiào róng.
1487.en: A kind and gentle smile is always on the old grandmother's face.

1488.zh: 校园里栽种着几棵挺拔的乔木大树。
1488.py: Xiào yuán lǐ zāi zhòng zhe jǐ kē tǐng bá de qiáo mù dà shù.
1488.en: Several upright arbor trees are planted in the campus.

1489.zh: 每天坚持阅览有益报刊能够拓宽知识面。
1489.py: Měi tiān jiān chí yuè lǎn yǒu yì bào kān néng gòu tuò kuān zhī shí miàn.
1489.en: Persisting in reading beneficial newspapers daily can broaden knowledge.

1490.zh: 夏天的体育课上，大家流了许多汗水。
1490.py: Xià tiān de tǐ yù kè shàng, dà jiā liú le xǔ duō hàn shuǐ.
1490.en: In the summer PE class, everyone shed a lot of sweat.

1491.zh: 春天柳树枝条上抽出了嫩绿的新芽。
1491.py: Chūn tiān liǔ shù zhī tiáo shàng chōu chū le nèn lǜ de xīn yá.
1491.en: Tender green sprouts grew on willow branches in spring.

1492.zh: 今天的事今天做，绝不要拖延拖拉。
1492.py: Jīn tiān de shì jīn tiān zuò, jué bú yào tuō yán tuō lā.
1492.en: Do today's things today, never delay or procrastinate.

1493.zh: 练习中国书法时要准备好毛笔和墨汁。
1493.py: Liàn xí zhōng guó shū fǎ shí yào zhǔn bèi hǎo máo bǐ hé mò zhī.
1493.en: Prepare brushes and ink when practicing Chinese calligraphy.

1494.zh: 面对困难和威胁时我们要保持冷静。
1494.py: Miàn duì kùn nán hé wēi xié shí wǒ men yào bǎo chí lěng jìng.
1494.en: Face difficulties and threats with calmness.

1495.zh: 桌上的花瓶里插着几朵盛开的玫瑰。
1495.py: Zhuō shàng de huā píng lǐ chā zhe jǐ duǒ shèng kāi de méi guī.
1495.en: Several blooming roses are inserted in the vase on the table.

1496.zh: 他在射箭比赛中全神贯注，箭法精准。
1496.py: Tā zài shè jiàn bǐ sài zhōng quán shén guàn zhù, jiàn fǎ jīng zhǔn.
1496.en: He was fully focused in the archery match with accurate shooting.

1961.py: Wǒ men zài shēng huó zhōng yào fā yáng shí jīn bù mèi de liáng hǎo pǐn dé.
1961.en: We should carry forward the good virtue of not pocketing found money.

1962.zh: 春天小燕子在院子屋檐下筑造了温暖鸟窝。
1962.py: Chūn tiān xiǎo yàn zi zài yuàn zi wū yán xià zhù zào le wēn nuǎn niǎo wō.
1962.en: Swallows built a warm nest under the courtyard eaves in spring.

1963.zh: 清晨闹钟响了，他迅速睁开双眼起床洗漱。
1963.py: Qīng chén nào zhōng xiǎng le, tā xùn sù zhēng kāi shuāng yǎn qǐ chuáng xǐ shù.
1963.en: Morning alarm rang, he opened eyes and got up to wash.

1964.zh: 全校师生携手同行，共同建设美丽和谐校园。
1964.py: Quán xiào shī shēng xié shǒu tóng háng, gòng tóng jiàn shè měi lì hé xié xiào yuán.
1964.en: Teachers and students work hand in hand to build a beautiful campus.

1965.zh: 南京中山陵依山而建，气势雄伟庄严宏大。
1965.py: Nán jīng zhōng shān líng yī shān ér jiàn, qì shì xióng wěi zhuāng yán hóng dà.
1965.en: Nanjing Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum leans against mountain, majestic.

1966.zh: 小妹妹一边画画，一边轻声哼唱欢快儿歌。
1966.py: Xiǎo mèi mèi yī biān huà huà, yī biān qīng shēng hēng chàng huān kuài ér gē.
1966.en: Younger sister drew pictures while humming cheerful nursery rhymes softly.

1967.zh: 冬天穿上一件纯棉保暖羽绒服感到格外温暖。
1967.py: Dōng tiān chuān shàng yī jiàn chún mián bǎo nuǎn yǔ róng fú gǎn dào gé wài wēn nuǎn.
1967.en: Wearing a pure-cotton warm down jacket in winter feels extra warm.

1968.zh: 今天天气晴朗明媚，非常适合去郊外散步。
1968.py: Jīn tiān tiān qì qíng lǎng míng mèi, fēi cháng shì hé qù jiāo wài sàn bù.
1968.en: Today's weather is sunny and bright, very suitable for outdoor walks.

1969.zh: 放学铃声响起，同学们收拾好书包走出教室。
1969.py: Fàng xué líng shēng xiǎng qǐ, tóng xué men shōu shí hǎo shū bāo zǒu chū jiào shì.
1969.en: The school-over bell rang, students packed bags and walked out.

1970.zh: 考试报名前请在系统里仔细填报个人信息。
1970.py: Kǎo shì bào míng qián qǐng zài xì tǒng lǐ zǐ xì tián bào gè rén xìn xī.
1970.en: Please fill in personal information carefully before exam registration.

1971.zh: 生态养殖场采用科学绿色饲料喂养家禽。
1971.py: Shēng tài yǎng zhí chǎng cǎi yòng kē xué lǜ sè sì liào wèi yǎng jiā qín.
1971.en: Ecological farms feed poultry with scientific green feed.

1972.zh: 剧烈运动后口渴难耐，喝了一大杯温水。
1972.py: Jù liè yùn dòng hòu kǒu kě nán nài, hē le yī dà bēi wēn shuǐ.
1972.en: Thirsty after intense workouts, drank a big cup of warm water.

1973.zh: 妈妈上班前温柔地亲吻了一下小宝宝额头。
1973.py: Mā mā shàng bān qián wēn róu de qīn wěn le yī xià xiǎo bǎo bǎo é tóu.
1973.en: Mom kissed the baby's forehead gently before going to work.

1974.zh: 在新年晚会上，同学们打扮成卡通人物造型。
1974.py: Zài xīn nián wǎn huì shàng, tóng xué men dǎ bàn chéng kǎ tōng rén wù zào xíng.
1974.en: At the New Year party, classmates dressed up as cartoon characters.

1975.zh: 面对成长中的逆境，我们要保持顽强意志。
1975.py: Miàn duì chéng zhǎng zhōng de nì jìng, wǒ men yào bǎo chí wán qiáng yì zhì.
1975.en: Facing adversity in growth, we should maintain tenacious willpower.

1976.zh: 刚炸好的金黄麻花口感清脆、香甜可口美味。
1976.py: Gāng zhà hǎo de jīn huáng má huā kǒu gǎn qīng cuì, xiāng tián kě kǒu měi wèi.
1976.en: Freshly fried golden twists are crispy, sweet, and delicious.

1977.zh: 跑完步后他大口喘着粗气坐在草地上休息。
1977.py: Pǎo wán bù hòu tā dà kǒu chuǎn zhe cū qì zuò zài cǎo dì shàng xiū xī.
1977.en: After running he panted heavily resting on the grass.

1978.zh: 清晨小山村的上空笼罩了一层迷蒙晨雾。
1978.py: Qīng chén xiǎo shān cūn de shàng kōng lǒng zhào le yī céng mí méng chén wù.
1978.en: A layer of misty morning fog shrouded the mountain village at dawn.

1979.zh: 胡萝卜富含维生素，多吃有助于保护视力。
1979.py: Hú luó bo fù hán wéi shēng sù, duō chī yǒu zhù yú bǎo hù shì lì.
1979.en: Carrots are rich in vitamins, eating more helps protect vision.

1980.zh: 冬天夜晚一家人围坐在温暖的火炉旁聊天。
1980.py: Dōng tiān yè wǎn yī jiā rén wéi zuò zài wēn nuǎn de huǒ lú páng liáo tiān.
1980.en: On winter nights the family sits around the warm stove chatting.

1981.zh: 柴米油盐酱醋茶生动展现了百姓生活日常。
1981.py: Chái mǐ yóu yán jiàng cù chá shēng dòng zhǎn xiàn le bǎi xìng shēng huó rì cháng.
1981.en: Firewood, rice, oil, salt, sauce, vinegar, and tea show daily life.

1982.zh: 全家人在郊外度过了一段愉快美好的时光。
1982.py: Quán jiā rén zài jiāo wài dù guò le yī duàn yú kuài měi hǎo de shí guāng.
1982.en: The whole family spent a pleasant and wonderful time in suburbs.

1983.zh: 运动会跳绳比赛上同学们动作敏捷轻盈。
1983.py: Yùn dòng huì tiào shéng bǐ sài shàng tóng xué men dòng zuò mǐn jié qīng yíng.
1983.en: In the sports meet jump rope contest, students were agile.

1984.zh: 定期检查汽车轮胎气压能确保长途行车安全。
1984.py: Dìng qī jiǎn chá qì chē lún tāi qì yā néng què bǎo zhǎng tú xíng chē ān quán.
1984.en: Checking car tire pressure regularly ensures safe driving.

1985.zh: 水库在汛期来临前做好了蓄水调洪准备。
1985.py: Shuǐ kù zài xùn qī lái lín qián zuò hǎo le xù shuǐ diào hóng zhǔn bèi.
1985.en: The reservoir made water storage and flood control preparations.

1986.zh: 保持每天充足睡眠是恢复充沛精力的大脑法则。
1986.py: Bǎo chí měi tiān chōng zú shuì mián shì huī fù chōng pèi jīng lì de dà nǎo fǎ zé.
1986.en: Keeping sufficient sleep daily is the brain law to restore energy.

1987.zh: 医务工作者在危急时刻竭尽全力救治病人生命。
1987.py: Yī wù gōng zuò zhě zài wēi jí shí kè jié jìn quán lì jiù zhì bìng rén shēng mìng.
1987.en: Medical staff do their utmost to save patients' lives in critical moments.

1988.zh: 在动物园里，他开心地用新鲜青草喂小白兔。
1988.py: Zài dòng wù yuán lǐ, tā kāi xīn de yòng xīn xiān qīng cǎo wèi xiǎo bái tù.
1988.en: At the zoo, he fed white rabbits happily with fresh grass.

1989.zh: 遇到困难要变通思考，不可做出愚蠢的傻事。
1989.py: Yù dào kùn nán yào biàn tōng sī kǎo, bù kě zuò chū yú chǔn de shǎ shì.
1989.en: Think flexibly when meeting difficulties, never doing silly things.

1990.zh: 看到同学在比赛中夺得大奖，大家由衷羡慕。
1990.py: Kàn dào tóng xué zài bǐ sài zhōng duó de dà jiǎng, dà jiā yóu zhōng xiàn mù.
1990.en: Seeing classmates win awards in competition, everyone admired sincerely.

1991.zh: 踢完激烈足球赛后，他浑身湿透但感到畅快。
1991.py: Tī wán jī liè zú qiú sài hòu, tā hún shēn shī tòu dàn gǎn dào chàng kuài.
1991.en: After intense soccer match, he was soaked in sweat but happy.

1992.zh: 做人要光明磊落，坚决反对一切奸诈行为。
1992.py: Zuò rén yào guāng míng lěi luò, jiān jué fǎn duì yī qiè jiān zhà xíng wéi.
1992.en: Be open and upright, resolutely opposing all treacherous acts.

1993.zh: 夏日午后，老爷爷坐在树荫下摇着蒲扇纳凉。
1993.py: Xià rì wǔ hòu, lǎo yé yé zuò zài shù yīn xià yáo zhe pú shàn nà liáng.
1993.en: In summer afternoon, grandpa sat under tree shade fanning a fan.

1994.zh: 同学们把新领到的教材整齐放进教室书柜。
1994.py: Tóng xué men bǎ xīn lǐng dào de jiào cái zhěng qí fàng jìn jiào shì shū guì.
1994.en: Students put new textbooks neatly into classroom bookcase.

1995.zh: 漫步在春天公园里，听到清脆悦耳的鸟鸣声。
1995.py: Màn bù zài chūn tiān gōng yuán lǐ, tīng dào qīng cuì yuè ěr de niǎo míng shēng.
1995.en: Strolling in park in spring, heard crisp and melodious birdsong.

1996.zh: 遇到红灯请自觉停下，切勿强行阻拦抢行穿行。
1996.py: Yù dào hóng dēng qǐng zì jué tíng xià, qiè wù qiáng xíng zǔ lán qiǎng xíng chuān xíng.
1996.en: Stop at red lights, never blocking or rushing forcefully across.

1997.zh: 十月一日是伟大祖国母亲的诞辰纪念日。
1997.py: Shí yuè yī rì shì wěi dà zǔ guó mǔ qīn de dàn chén jì niàn rì.
1997.en: October 1st is the birthday anniversary of motherland.

1998.zh: 晚饭妈妈做了可口饭菜，大家吃得很饱美餐。
1998.py: Wǎn fàn mā mā zuò le kě kǒu fàn cài, dà jiā chī de hěn bǎo měi cān.
1998.en: Mom cooked delicious dinner, everyone ate full.

1999.zh: 乾隆是中国历史上清代著名的繁荣盛世皇帝。
1999.py: Qián lóng shì zhōng guó lì shǐ shàng qīng dài zhù míng de fán róng shèng shì huáng dì.
1999.en: Qianlong was a famous prosperous emperor in Chinese Qing dynasty.

2000.zh: 冬天晚上用一盆热水泡泡双脚能消除疲劳。
2000.py: Dōng tiān wǎn shàng yòng yī pén rè shuǐ pào pào shuāng jiǎo néng xiāo chú pí láo.
2000.en: Soaking feet in hot water on winter nights eliminates fatigue.
